Definition: Ramah, the name of four places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ramah is the name of four places in Palestine — the Ramah of Samuel, the Ramah of Benjamin, and others. Elkanah and Hannah returned to their house at Ramah; Samuel judged Israel there and built an altar there; and Baasha king of Israel built Ramah, to keep any from going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that Ramah is where Samuel lived and judged: the prophet's home, the place Israel came for judgment, and the town a king fortified against his brother — all in one name.
